name: Coiled Clover
desc: A coil arranged into the shape of a clover. It may look like the coils are merely stuck together, but this design was meticulously fine-tuned to produce dramatically more power than four coils used normally.

eff.name: Synthesis: SPD Up+
eff.desc1: Using this as an ingredient for synthesis increases the synthesized item's SPD by [Lv. x 1].

eff.name: Increase Resonance Area - Star
eff.desc1: When used as an ingredient for a star-shaped Alchemy Core, increases the resonance area by [Lv. x 1].
